items.issue: Pixel pitch/grid versus actual optical resolution
items.guard: 10.8 micrometer DMD pitch and 64x64 outputs do not establish 10.8 micrometer resolved detail. Main reports approximately 91 micrometers resolution. Coordinate mapping requires qualification.

items.issue: Photon number versus total image dose
items.guard: Incident mean photons per pulse is not photons per image. Long accumulation and many masks contribute many incident pulses.
Approximately 10 Hz concerns analog 16x16 video; do not combine it with 64x64 or photon-sparse limits.
0.5 photons/pulse is full photon-sparse imaging; the denoised 25% compressed demonstration reaches 1 photon/pulse. These are different experiments.
Movie1 compares intended, measured pump and corrected pump patterns. Representative SFG images are in Fig2/SI FigS3; Movie1 does not visually prove full-set SFG fidelity.
The 32x32 panel is labeled 2.5 Hz with 4x display speed, despite a 10fps video container. Description says reported acquisition rates include reconstruction.
The unnormalized plus/minus-one matrix is orthogonal up to N. An authored implementation must pin normalization; shorthand orthonormal language must not cause amplitude errors.
A denoised image may look clean without validating true structure. Keep raw/baseline/residual evidence, independent target truth and algorithm configuration.
SI encoding comparison holds illumination power fixed; total exposure, detected photons and physical displays require separate accounting.
SI Note3 contains an apparent malformed FPGA logic-element count (68,0000). Do not silently repair or use it as a hardware purchasing/interface specification.
